# nanelo Provider

Manages DNS records in [Nanelo](https://nanelo.com).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nanelo = {
      source = "bekkopen/nanelo"
    }
  }
}

# The API key can also be set with NANELO_API_KEY. With a domain-bound key the zone is
# looked up automatically; team keys need zone here or on each resource.
provider "nanelo" {
  api_key = var.nanelo_api_key
  zone    = "example.org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Nanelo API key. Can also be set with the `NANELO_API_KEY` environment variable. Keys are either bound to a single domain or to a team/workspace.
- `zone` (String) Default zone for resources and data sources that don't set `zone`. Can also be set with the `NANELO_ZONE` environment variable. Not needed for domain-bound keys, where the zone is looked up.
